output.summary: Zero deviations since February 17 coincide with rising customer complaints (11 to 31 ppm), mostly luer-bond leaks traced to Line 3 lots. This points to suppressed reporting, not real improvement. Training began after the drop and was only partly completed, so it does not explain the drop. The tubing switch is contradicted, since Lines 2 and 5 use the same tubing and have few complaints. Line 3's output gain with flat headcount, while Lines 1 and 4 fell, and uncertified technicians badged into its cell, suggests borrowed labor, not transferable practices. Preferred actions are an independent investigation and removing the reporting penalty. Do not replicate Line 3 or hunt the hotline reporter. Discipline would be premature.
